title: Turbocharging PiPNN for Proximity and $k$-NN Graph Building
abstract: arXiv:2611.05690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) indexes such as HNSW and Vamana deliver state-of-the-art query performance at the cost of large indexing times. The recently introduced PiPNN method drastically accelerated index construction by way of a partitioning-based algorithm leveraging dense matrix multiplication and top-$K$ aggregation kernels.   In this paper, we unlock the full potential of PiPNN's hardware-friendly algorithm design. We introduce PiPNN II, which optimizes multiple steps of the PiPNN recipe, giving up to $8\times$ speedups for graph-based ANNS index construction. In addition, we present GPiPNN, a GPU implementation which builds comparable ANNS indices up to $43.7\times$ faster than Jasper and up to $50\times$ faster than CAGRA. We also extend PiPNN II and GPiPNN to compute high-quality $k$-NN graphs directly, which unlocks massive speedups over methods used in many existing systems for clustering, anomaly

translated_title: 为邻近图与k近邻图构建提速的PiPNN全面优化
translated_abstract: 基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）索引（如HNSW和Vamana）提供了最先进的查询性能，但代价是漫长的索引构建时间。最近提出的PiPNN方法通过一种基于分区的算法，利用稠密矩阵乘法和top-K聚合内核，大幅加速了索引构建。本文充分释放了PiPNN硬件友好算法设计的潜力。我们提出PiPNN II，对PiPNN方案的多个步骤进行了优化，使基于图的ANNS索引构建速度提升高达8倍。此外，我们提出了GPiPNN这一GPU实现，其构建的ANNS索引质量相当，但速度比Jasper快高达43.7倍，比CAGRA快高达50倍。我们还将PiPNN II和GPiPNN扩展为可直接计算高质量k-NN图，为许多现有系统中用于聚类、异常检测等任务的方法带来了巨大的加速。
tldr: 本文提出优化版PiPNN II及其GPU实现GPiPNN，将基于图的近似最近邻索引构建速度最高提升8倍（CPU），并比CAGRA快最高50倍，还可直接高效构建高质量k-NN图。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PiPNN II and its GPU implementation GPiPNN, achieving up to 8x speedups for CPU-based graph ANNS index construction and building indices up to 50x faster than CAGRA, while also enabling fast direct construction of high-quality k-NN graphs.
